text.text:
Great to see you here! Snap'N'Go assigns you small tasks throughout the day that you can get paid for completing.

*Two types of tasks:*
• *Data collection* — Take a photo that matches the task. Accept first, then submit.
• *Verification* — Review someone else's photo: see our AI's decision and click Agree or Disagree. Compensation is added *immediately* when you complete either type.

*Each task shows:*
• *Start Time* — when the task opens
• *Window* — how long it's open
• *Description* — what to do
• *Compensation* — points you earn

TaskBot will send you tasks through DMs. Reply `help` or `?` anytime for full instructions!

*Submitting a photo (data collection tasks):*
    *1.* Complete the task
    *2.* Go to the TaskBot DM channel
    *3.* Type the task number and attach the image (see below)
    *4.* Send! Compensation is added right away.
Type `?` or `help` for more info. Reply `account` to see your balance. We'll send you your first tasks soon!
